raw.description:
DevOps Engineer

12 months contract

India, Remote

Growth through diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an ethical business, we do what is right — including ensuring equal opportunities and fostering a safe, respectful workplace for each of us. We believe diversity fuels both personal and business growth. We're committed to building an inclusive community where all our people thrive regardless of their backgrounds, identities, or other personal characteristics.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Platform Design, Development & Evolution: Architect, build, and continuously evolve the core M&O platform and services, leveraging modern technologies and best practices to provide comprehensive observability and data quality functions.
  • Ensuring System Reliability & Performance: Actively maintain and enhance the stability, availability, and performance of critical applications and data infrastructure by integrating Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles directly into the platform's design and operation.
  • Proactive Issue Detection & Resolution: Develop and integrate intelligent systems within the platform to proactively identify, diagnose, and trigger automated or semi-automated resolution for technical issues, performance bottlenecks, and anomalies across all operational and data systems.
  • Advanced Data Quality Platform Implementation: Build and integrate capabilities within the M&O platform for continuously measuring, monitoring, and reporting on all critical data quality dimensions (Timeliness, Consistency, Completeness, Accuracy, Validity, Uniqueness) across diverse supply chain pipelines, including Warehousing, Transformation, SAP, Manufacturing, and other critical data sources.
  • Centralized Insights & Dashboarding: Develop and manage a unified dashboarding interface (e.g., Grafana, Power BI, Databricks) within the platform to visualize key performance indicators, system health, operational metrics, financial insights (FinOps), and granular data quality metrics for various stakeholders.
  • Automating Infrastructure & Operations: Drive the platform's automation capabilities through Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and extensive scripting (Python, Shell) for provisioning, deployment, and operational workflows.
  • Managing Core Data & Cloud Technologies: Integrate and optimize essential technologies like Fivetran, AKS, Kafka, Azure SQL Server, Databricks, and Flink into the M&O platform, ensuring seamless operation and data flow within the Azure cloud environment.
  • Optimizing Cloud Resources & Costs: Embed FinOps practices and reporting into the platform to monitor cloud resource utilization and spending, identifying opportunities for cost reduction and ensuring efficient allocation of infrastructure investments.
  • Fostering a Culture of Continuous Improvement: Leverage platform data and SRE practices to continuously analyze operational incidents, performance trends, and data quality issues, driving ongoing enhancements to both the platform and the systems it monitors.
  • Enabling Data-Driven Decision Making & Compliance: Ensure the M&O platform provides accurate, timely data and insights, derived from both monitoring and high-quality data across all domains, to support informed business decisions, while also guaranteeing compliance with regulatory requirements for data integrity and auditability.

What We’re Looking For:

    • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a similar role.
    • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud infrastructure.
    • Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and containerized environments.
    • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
    • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and Shell scripting.
    • Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, and observability and monitoring solutions.
    • Strong understanding and practical experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles.
    • Experience with Kafka, Azure SQL Server, Databricks, Flink, and Fivetran.
    • Experience with infrastructure automation, system monitoring, performance optimization, and incident management.

raw.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the role:

The Commissions Manager at JumpCloud plays a critical strategic role in aligning our incentives strategy with our fast-growing revenue generating engine. In this role, you will oversee the end-to-end commissions lifecycle, from the strategic design of sales plans to the execution of payout calculations and communication of statements to reps. You will act as a key advisor in exceptions management, deal attribution, and incentive optimization to drive high performance across our global teams. By leveraging modern automation and AI-driven tools, you will transform how commissions are calculated, validated, and analyzed at JumpCloud.
You will directly influence and drive the motivation of JumpCloud's global sales team by ensuring fair, transparent, and accurate incentive compensation. This role offers the unique opportunity to blend strategic design with AI technology, moving commissions from a back-office administration task to a forward-looking intelligence hub.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead strategic conversations with sales and executive teams to design and distribute optimized commission plans that are aligned with company strategy.

  • Calculate and execute monthly and quarterly commission payouts with absolute accuracy, resolving exceptions and deal attribution questions.

  • Coordinate commission plan statement delivery to sales representatives, maintaining high trust and transparency.

  • Set up and configure the end-to-end data pipelines for the commission tool implementation.

  • Implement AI-driven anomaly detection models to flag discrepancies between payouts and actual attainments.

  • Build and maintain the knowledge base required to feed the AI-driven Q&A bot for terms and conditions.

  • Generate validation checks and bell curve analytics to evaluate plan effectiveness and make recommendations to leadership.

What Success Looks Like:

    In your first 6–12 months, you'll be measured against these outcomes:

    • Commission Tool Implementation Finalization & Utilization: Successfully complete the implementation of and drive 100% utilization of JumpCloud's new commission tool within the first 6 months, transitioning manual tracking to an automated, scalable system.

    • End-to-End Attainment & Performance Reporting: Establish comprehensive analytics dashboards within 6 months, including productivity reporting, validation check reporting, and individual/team performance tracking, amongst others.

    • AI-Driven Support System Launch: Deploy an AI-driven bot within 12 months that accurately responds to sales queries regarding terms, conditions, and commission questions, reducing manual inquiry load by at least 50%.

    • Presidents Club Attainment Sourcing: Fully automate and source Presidents Club attainment eligibility directly from final, validated commission attainment files by month 12.

    • Strategic Plan Execution: Master and execute the end-to-end design, distribution, calculation, and communication of commission plans, ensuring alignment with JumpCloud's revenue goals within 6 months.

We're looking for:

    Must-have functional skills:

  • Incentive plan design and strategic modeling in alignment with revenue engines.

  • End-to-end commission payout calculations, validation, and exceptions management.

  • Advanced data analysis, modeling, and reporting (attainment, productivity, and bell curves).

  • Experience with commission tool utilization as a key part of commissions processing.

    • Tools or systems knowledge:

  • Enterprise-grade commission management software (e.g., Everstage, CaptivateIQ, Spiff, Xactly, or similar).

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker).

    • Behavioral or power skills:

  • Strong collaborative communication skills to manage exceptions and plan alignment with sales reps and leadership.

  • High attention to detail and analytical rigor.

  • Proactive problem-solving and tech-forward mindset.

Bonus points:

  • SaaS/Tech sales incentive frameworks and compensation structures.

  • AI and automation tools application in financial operations (anomaly detection, natural language querying).

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.

Language:

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

raw.description:
We are more than a health system. We are a belief system. We believe wellness and sickness are both part of a lifelong partnership, and that everyone could use an expert guide. We work hard, care deeply and reach further to help people uncover their own power to be healthy. We inspire hope. We learn, grow, and achieve more – in our careers and in our communities.

Job Description Summary:

This position is responsible for preparing and reviewing the Medicare and Medicaid cost reports for all OhioHealth entities.

•This position will be responsible for ensuring the appropriate governmental (Medicare and Medicaid) reimbursement is received for OhioHealth.
•This position is primarily responsible for the proactive calculations and modeling of new regulatory changes and impacts as well as variance analysis of third-party liability accounts. Provides supporting work papers and documentation for third-party inquires.
•This position has supervisory oversight of the Reimbursement Analyst daily work schedule including flow of information, teaching of reimbursement fundamentals and principals, review of work and setting daily priorities.
•This positon supports the Director of Revenue and Reimbursement and Manager of Reimbursement with many special analysis throughout the year associated with revenue cycle, charge analysis, regulatory and financial reporting.
•The Senior Reimbursement Consultant will be a subject matter expert in the following areas, S-10, Wage Index, Bad Debts, Medicare Audits, Disproportionate Share, Indirect Medical Education, Graduate Medical Education, and Governmental Logs, (HCAP, UPL and Franchise Fee programs in the state of Ohio) as well as special projects as assigned.
•Extensive knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid cost reporting and reimbursement and remaining up to date with all regulatory requirements, both federal and state is required.
•The Reimbursement Consultant position leads, advises and consults various reimbursement financial projects, as well as special projects throughout the year and needs to be able to delegate direct reports assigned to the project or process while staying connected to both the pertinent details as well as the high level strategic purpose.
•The Senior Reimbursement Consultant is required to use extensive interpersonal skills in communicating with all management levels at OhioHealth.
•This role functions in a heavily matrixed environment and requires strong prioritization, communication and planning skills.

Responsibilities And Duties:

Consulting and oversite of key areas at OhioHealth in the central Ohio facilities as well as non-central Ohio facilities in the reimbursement functions.

Knowledge in the following areas:

Reimbursement functions:

Subject matter expert on CMS cost reporting, disproportionate share (DSH), Uncompensated Care, Bad debt reporting, IME/GME, Medicare Wage Index, S-10 reporting, Tricare and 855’s, Ohio Medicaid, HCAP, UPL and Franchise Fee programs. Knowledge of Acute Care Hospitals, Critical Access Hospitals, Sole Community Hospitals and Rural Health Clinics. Knowledge of reimbursement in specialty areas such psych, inpatient rehabilitation units, Home Health and Hospice. Projects as assigned by Director of Revenue and Reimbursement and Manager of Reimbursement. Provide Director of Revenue and Reimbursement and Manager with updates. CGS audits and auditors Working with our legal vendor for Medicare Appeals. Working with OHA and CBSA facilities on wage index opportunities Special projects / analysis as assigned by the Director of Revenue and Reimbursement and Manager of Reimbursement.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree: Finance (Required)

Additional Job Description:

Min: Proficiency in Microsoft applications, knowledge of clinical & financial patient management systems, demonstrated ability in financial analysis and cost reporting.

Day

40

raw.description:
About Bodwé Group Companies

Bodwé is the Professional Services Group of Mno-Bmadsen, the investment enterprise and a wholly owned instrumentality of the Pokagon Band of Potawatomi. We are architects, planners, consultants, designers, engineers, scientists, and federal contractors, committed to growing the economy and legacy of the Pokagon Band and supporting its more than 6,000 citizens. We provide value by integrating expertise across the natural and built environment lifecycle—from pre-development and planning to design, procurement, construction, and operations. By integrating expertise across architecture, engineering, construction, and facility management, we deliver holistic, end-to-end solutions that drive efficiency and deliver distinctive outcomes.

Position Summary

The BID / Real Property Analyst position is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining business intelligence solutions, which include interactive dashboards that enable data-driven decision making, while aiding the team in analytical efforts to support Office of The Surgeon General (OTSG)/MEDCOM. Duties will include sustaining dashboard deliverables in support of Medical Readiness. Duties include building data models, tools, and visualizations within dashboard programs such as Power BI, which includes 19 training team members and reviewing teammate work for data integration. The BID works closely with the Program Manager and Data Analysts to check the integrity of the data and deliverables, in support of OTSG/MEDCOM. The Analyst will support team efforts including, but not limited to, ad hoc queries, project analysis, data calls, and other analytical support efforts, as needed.

Accommodation Requests

We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, contact .

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The following inexhaustive list of duties represents a sample of work routinely performed by this role:

  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, data models, and visualizations supporting OTSG/MEDCOM reporting and analysis.
  • Develop Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), metrics, scorecards, and analytical visualizations aligned with the Medical Readiness mission.
  • Utilize Microsoft Power BI and other BI/analytics platforms to transform complex datasets into actionable information.
  • Conduct statistical analysis, identify trends and patterns, interpret results, and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Respond to ad hoc data queries, data calls, project analysis, and analytical support requirements.
  • Gather and integrate information from multiple sources, including databases, spreadsheets, and organizational data repositories.
  • Develop, document, maintain, and continuously improve data-analysis and BI processes.

Data Quality & Integration

  • Validate data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrityprior to integration and delivery.
  • Review team members' BI submissions and deliverables to ensure adherence to established standards.
  • Identify data inconsistencies, integration issues, and potential risks and coordinate corrective actions.
  • Standardize BI deliverables and minimize incompatibilities across data sources and reporting platforms.
  • Maintain organized BI files, repositories, storage environments, and sharing capabilities.
  • Establish timelines, milestones, and delivery dates for dashboard updates and BI projects.

Real Property Analysis

  • Review project and facility data supporting the Facilities Investment Plan and related Army real property initiatives.
  • Analyze and validate facility information within applicable Army Real Property Systems.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert supporting Army Real Property data, systems, processes, and reporting.
  • Obtain and maintain appropriate access to applicable real property systems, including:
    • DAIS
    • GFEBS
    • HWIID
    • ISR
    • ePRISMS
    • LOGICOLE
    • FROID
    • ASIP
    • BUILDER
    • Vantage
    • RPLANS

Stakeholder Engagement & Customer Support

  • Meet with government and organizational stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate mission needs into BI solutions.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for BI-related support under the contract.
  • Collaborate with the Contract Program Manager and Data Analysts to refine requirements, processes, instructions, and deliverables.
  • Provide exceptional customer service throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Communicate complex analytical information clearly to senior leadership, government stakeholders, colleagues, and project teams.
  • Prepare and deliver briefings, presentations, and demonstrations both virtually and in person.

Team Leadership & Training

  • Train team members on Power BI, dashboard development, data integration, and BI deliverables.
  • Lead, mentor, and support project staff on Business Intelligence and Real Property Systems initiatives.
  • Review teammate work and provide guidance to improve data quality and deliverable consistency.
  • Assist team members in meeting analytical assignments, dashboard requirements, project milestones, and deadlines.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, process improvement, and consistent BI practices across the team.

Program & Project Support

  • Work closely with the Program Manager to identify and address data integration risks, project challenges, and delivery requirements.
  • Establish project goalposts, milestones, and dashboard update schedules.
  • Support program execution through analytical research, data calls, reporting, and special projects.
  • Ensure deliverables are accurate, standardized, timely, and aligned with government requirements.
  • Travel to various CONUS locations when required to support program execution.

Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

Required Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Research Analyst, or comparable analytical role.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred but not required.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in:
    • Business Intelligence
    • Data analytics
    • Statistical analysis
    • Dataset analysis
    • Data visualization
    • Microsoft Power BI
    • Microsoft Office Suite
  • Ability to analyze complex information, interpret results, identify trends, and develop recommendations.
  • Experience working with multiple data sources and integrating information from databases, spreadsheets, and other repositories.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with government stakeholders, program managers, analysts, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong customer-service orientation.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently.
  • Ability to train, mentor, and support team members.
  • Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a Real ID or Passport in order to undergo commercial airfare travel
  • Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a valid driver's license

Preferred Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

  • Bachelor's degree preferred but not required.

Working Environment

This position operates in a professional office setting. The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, and photocopiers. The work environment is generally quiet and free from exposure to loud noise, hazardous materials, or heavy machinery. Employees are typically seated for extended periods and may occasionally move about the office to attend meetings or access equipment and supplies.

Physical Demands

Sitting/Standing: This role is generally sedentary, performing sitting work utilizing technological office equipment, including a laptop, mouse, keyboard, computer monitors, telephones, scanners, and copiers.

Walking: This role requires the ability to move about inside the office to access the required technological equipment.

Stooping/Kneeling/Crouching/Crawling: This role may require stooping to reload printer trays with print paper, moving equipment, and managing cords.

Using Hands/Fingers:This role constantly operates technological office equipment such as laptops, mice, keyboards, computer monitors, telephones, scanners, and copiers.

Talking/Hearing: This role requires constant communication with others in the organization to exchange information, review information, and make decisions about information.

Seeing: This role requires seeing, viewing, and distinguishing all aspects of internal and external communications.

Carrying/Lifting:This role requires lifting up to 20lbs to transport technological office equipment to and from various workspaces.

Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Bodwé Group Companies engage in federal contracting. Therefore, we would be thrilled to accept applications or referrals to hire veterans.

Native American Hiring Preference

Our parent company, Mno-Bmadsen, prefers to hire Pokagon citizens who are qualified and suitable for available positions. For purposes of this section, “qualified” means that the applicant meets the technical and experiential needs for employment; and “suitable” means that the candidate appears to be the best fit considering present circumstances and conditions. Targeted preference is in the following order:

  • First, to qualified Pokagon Band citizens; and
  • Second, to qualified spouses and qualified custodial parents; and
  • Third, to other qualified Native Americans; and
  • Fourth, to all other qualified applicants

Any determinations as to the applicability of the Pokagon hiring preference are at the discretion of each Company President.

Home Office Connectivity Requirements for Hybrid & Remote Positions

To ensure reliable collaboration, client service, and secure access to company systems, the Company requires minimum connectivity standards to be eligible or remain eligible to work in a hybrid or remote capacity. Employees working remotely must maintain broadband internet service capable of consistently supporting video conferencing, VPN connectivity, and cloud-based applications. Hybrid or remote work eligibility may be reassessed if connectivity standards are not met. This includes:

  • Wired broadband service (cable, fiber, or DSL) with at least minimum 100 Mbps download / 20 Mbps upload
  • Some positions may require minimum 200-300 Mbps download / 25-35 Mbps upload speed

Cellular hotspot or fixed wireless cellular services (e.g., T-Mobile Home Internet) may not be used as a primary connection. The Company will comply with all local, state, and federal requirements as it relates to the reimbursement of home internet expenses. Eligibility for reimbursement of home internet expenses is defined in a separate policy.

About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

General Summary

Avalere Health is a strategic advisory company whose core purpose is to create innovative solutions to complex healthcare problems. Based in Washington, DC with consultants located across the U.S. and the world, the firm delivers actionable insights, product solutions, and custom analytics for leaders in healthcare business and policy. Avalere's experts span over 200 staff drawn from Fortune 500 healthcare companies, the federal government (e.g., CMS, OMB, CBO, and Congress), top consultancies, and nonprofits. The firm offers deep substance on the full range of healthcare business issues affecting the Fortune 500 healthcare companies. Avalere’s focus on strategy is supported by outstanding data analytics that generate unique insights and meaningful business improvement. Through events, publications, and interactive programs, Avalere insights are accessible to a broad range of customers. For more information, visit avalere.com, or follow us on Twitter @avalerehealth.

Avalere Health is seeking a Research Scientist I to join our Evidence & Strategy Practice. The practice focuses on a range of issues including developing value-based assessments and supporting evidence generation; quantitative, qualitative, and feasibility studies utilizing a broad range of open and closed source datasets; go-to-market strategies and tactics for an evidence-differentiated offering. We rely on deep subject matter expertise and understanding of the business issues facing our clients to assess how the changing healthcare evidence, market access and policy landscape impacts the pharmaceutical industry, managed care plans, providers, and consumers. We provide analytic support and advisory services, including legislative strategy, regulatory analysis, and quantitative modeling of proposed and enacted policies to a wide range of clients across the healthcare industry.

About the role

    Research Scientist Duties and Responsibilities

    · Perform data management activities to generate analytic-ready dataset, such as importing, transforming, merging and validating data to deliver accurate, reproducible results using SQL and/or SAS

    Perform descriptive and basic statistical analysis using large patient and/or claims databases in support of economic and outcomes modeling to execute analysis plans and support client strategic objectives

    · Independently develops and troubleshoots code, resolves data issues, and seeks guidance on higher-risk methodological or client-impacting decisions.

    · Contributes to the development of concept proposals, scope of work, budgets, and analysis plans

    · Independently manages workflow and make direct contributions to the research and analysis process

    · Works within and across organizational analytics teams to identify areas for delivering innovation to clients

    · Ensuring the accuracy, quality, and consistency of analytic outputs.

About you

    Skills, Experience, and Other Job-Related Requirements

    Minimum Requirements:

    · BA/BS or higher in computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics, data science, epidemiology, statistics or related discipline

    · 3+ years of SAS or SQL programming experience in a work setting

    · Experience analyzing large administrative pharmacy and medical claims databases (public and private)

    · Experience with importing data, transforming, cleaning, merging, and editing data and extensive quality/accuracy measures

    · Working knowledge of basic statistical techniques and/or econometric skills

    · Demonstrated problem solving, analytical reasoning and decision-making skills and strong commitment to meeting goals and deadlines

    · Positive, flexible and self-motivated attitude, with excellent teamwork skills and ability to work in a multi-disciplinary environment

    · Comfortable working in a remote/hybrid environment with demonstrated ability to be productive and self-guided.

    Additional Skills and Competencies:

    · Healthcare policy and analysis background

    · Experience with analyzing healthcare survey data (e.g Medical Expenditure Panel Survey and Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey)

    · Experience interpreting basic statistical output and analyses

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

raw.description:
About Lyra Health

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About the Role

Lyra Health is looking for a Quality Improvement Lead to support our Clinical Quality Department and ensure high-quality, safe, and compliant care. This role supports continuous survey readiness and adherence to regulatory and accreditation standards (e.g. The Joint commission Behavioral Health Care and Human Services standards), and is responsible for enhancing care, safety and operational efficiency by analyzing data, identifying areas for improvement and implementing evidence-based strategies. They play a key role in fostering a culture of continuous improvement across our organization and guide cross-functional teams in improving program performance.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead Behavioral Health Performance Improvement activities, track performance trends and incidents, conduct Root Cause Analysis, and ensure high quality and culturally responsive care.

  • Lead continuous survey readiness activities (mock surveys, tracer methodology) for external audits, interpret and operationalize regulatory requirements into clinical workflows and policies, ensure contracted services meet accreditation standards, and ensure ongoing compliance with all applicable regulations and standards (e.g., The Joint Commission Behavioral Health standards).

  • Conduct chart audits for timely assessments, treatment plans, medical necessity, and discharge planning, identify risks and implement corrective actions, and partner with supervisors on provider documentation issues

  • Track key metrics, support Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE) and Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) processes for licensed providers, and develop dashboards and reports for leadership review.

  • Educate staff on documentation, risk assessment, incident reporting, and quality improvement processes, support competency validation, and address performance gaps with leadership.

  • Coordinate Behavioral Health Quality/Performance Improvement Committee, partner with Risk Management/Compliance on investigations and mitigation strategies, and support Performance Improvement plan development and annual evaluation.

  • Analyze, develop and monitor clinical QI activities to ensure compliance with customer guarantees and lead clinical quality audits with benefits and customer teams

  • Investigate and resolve behavioral health quality of care complaints and grievances

  • Other duties as assigned

Competencies:

    Knowledge

  • Clinical Knowledge: A strong understanding of mental health conditions, empirically supported treatment options, and patient progress evaluation.

  • Knowledge of Cultural Factors: Ability to recognize cultural, linguistic, and socioeconomic differences in client populations and sharing this information with the interprofessional team to ensure accurate communication with diverse clients, families and needs.

  • Virtual Platforms and Remote Services: Ability to interact through secure virtual platforms. Ability to maintain the integrity, privacy, and security of private and confidential data in a virtual health care setting.

  • Detail Oriented/Documentation: Proficiency with utilizing Electronic Health Record(s), and other platforms as needed, and attention to ensuring all verbal and written communication is accurate, private, and secure. Ensure accuracy and timeliness in submitting documentation within the electronic health record.

    • Practice Based Learning & Improvement

  • Utilize Scientific Evidence in Practice: Stay up to date on all required and applicable, role, program, and company training.

  • Adaptability to Technologies: Flexibility in learning new technologies and staying up-to-date on advances in virtual healthcare delivery.

  • Self Assessment and Reflection: Ability to think critically and adjust processes in real-time when needed, consulting with the interprofessional team if modifications are required based on client needs.

    • Interpersonal and Communication

  • Collaboration and Interprofessional Communication: Strong ability to work collaboratively with supervisors, team leads, and other clinical staff, contributing to the development and execution of communication, services, and plans. Ability to effectively coordinate with interprofessional teams to communicate updates and adapt communication as needed.

    • System Based Practice

  • Awareness of System: Understands systems policies, protocols, and processes, and demonstrates compliance, as evidenced by ability to verbalize, or explain policies, protocols, and processes and knowledge how systems support access and care.

  • Promoting Safety and Quality: Works effectively within a team to enhance patient safety and improve the quality of care, including identifying and support opportunities to improve care across different programs.

    • Professionalism

  • Ethical and Confidential Practice: Adherence to legal and ethical standards in health care delivery, maintaining patient confidentiality, and ensuring HIPAA-compliant documentation and communication.

  • Time Management, Organization, and Responsivity: Ability to balance multiple tasks, including managing schedules, and collaborating with the quality team, while maintaining accurate records and staying organized. Ability to manage a task list, and set priorities effectively. Demonstrated ability to manage time effectively while ensuring timely communication and follow-up within and outside the clinical team, the client/family, and their community ensuring continuity of care.

Qualifications:

  • Master’s or doctoral degree from a behavioral health clinical track (e.g., LCSW, LMHC, LPC, MSW, LMFT, LPC, Ph.D, Psy.D.)

  • Current unrestricted license to practice within the United States

  • 3+ years in behavioral health, quality improvement, or compliance, with experience in chart audits, incident review, and regulatory surveys.

  • Strong understanding of Behavioral Health clinical workflows and documentation requirements, coupled with a high attention to detail and regulatory compliance.

  • Knowledge of performance improvement methodologies (PDSA, Lean, Six Sigma).

  • Data analysis and interpretation skills.

  • Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and influence practice change.

kurzbeschreibung

Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Prozesse rund um Entwicklung, Bereitstellung und Betrieb zuverlässig und effizient funktionieren. Du kannst uns in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit unterstützen und hast die Möglichkeit remote oder an einem unserer Standorte zu arbeiten.

deine rolle in unserem team

  • Du konzipierst, betreibst und optimierst unsere CI/CD-Prozesse und sorgst für stabile, nachvollziehbare und effiziente Build-, Test- und Deployment-Abläufe
  • Du betreibst und automatisierst unsere Linux-Systeme sowie die zugrunde liegende Betriebsumgebung
  • Du betreust containerisierte Anwendungen und Webservices und unterstützt deren zuverlässigen und wartbaren Betrieb
  • Du setzt Systemintegrationen und automatisierte Workflows zur Anbindung interner und externer Anwendungen, APIs und Webservices um

  • Du unterstützt bei Bedarf bei der Bearbeitung von Infrastruktur-Tickets und im IT-Support

das bringst du mit

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Umgebungen und verstehst, worauf es bei zuverlässigen automatisierten Prozessen in Entwicklung und Betrieb ankommt
  • Du kennst Dich mit Containerisierung und dem Betrieb containerisierter Anwendungen aus
  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der Administration und Automatisierung von Linux-Systemen mit
  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Deployments, Configuration Management sowie den stabilen Betrieb von Webservices und Anwendungen
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Systemintegrationen, API-Anbindungen und der Automatisierung von Workflows
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Monitoring, Alerting und technischer Fehleranalyse
  • Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Infrastruktur, Netzwerke und technische Supportprozesse mit
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und bringst gerne eigene Ideen ein

Idealerweise hast Du bereits mit einigen dieser Technologien gearbeitet:
GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Linux, Ansible, Docker, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Podman, Renovate, Dependabot, n8n, Make, Zapier, Microsoft Power Automate, Icinga, Grafana Alloy, Prometheus, Zabbix, Nagios, REST-APIs, Webhooks, JSON / YAML, OAuth 2.0 / SAML

Du musst nicht alle genannten Technologien mitbringen. Wichtiger ist uns, dass Du fachlich zu der Rolle passt, Zusammenhänge schnell verstehst und Lust hast, unsere Infrastruktur aktiv mitzugestalten.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Model Serving Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Salary Range: $74,000–$98,000 Annually
Experience Required: 7+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Model Serving Engineer to design, build, and operate high-performance, highly reliable inference platforms for serving large machine learning models in production. The role focuses on the systems engineering side of AI deployment, including request routing, batching, caching, autoscaling, GPU utilization, and end-to-end observability across diverse model workloads. The ideal candidate brings strong distributed systems and performance engineering expertise, has shipped serving systems at scale, and understands the trade-offs between latency, throughput, cost, and quality in ML serving.

Why join Safeguard Global?

We want to help you “Work in Any Way” - that makes time for family, commitments, and life outside, so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work.

Our roles aren’t just remote and hybrid first—they break free from the traditional ways of doing things, paving a way for A Job That Works for You.

The role in a nutshell:

The HR Services Manager plays a pivotal role in delivering high-quality, legally compliant HR Business Partnering support to a diverse portfolio of global clients, including Embedded clients (reseller) and HR Consulting clients. As the primary HR point of contact for workers, clients, and in-country partners, this role is responsible for effectively managing the full employee lifecycle and ensuring seamless coordination across all HR functions with defined service scope, SLAs and workflows. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of employment law, HR best practices, and the ability to lead complex HR initiatives in a fast-paced, global environment. This role also requires creative thinking, a can-do attitude, and a proactive, consultative approach to client needs. The HR Services Manager must anticipate client needs, provide up-front knowledge to mitigate risk, and ask probing questions to uncover the full context of client inquiries.

How you will make a difference:

  • Act as the primary HR point of contact for GEO workers and client stakeholders, delivering professional and compliant support across the full employee lifecycle (onboarding to offboarding).
  • Provide day-to-day HR and benefits support, including guidance on statutory and supplemental benefits (eligibility, enrollment, changes), ensuring clear and effective worker communication.
  • Deliver HR and benefits briefings aligned with local labor laws and company policies to ensure understanding and compliance.
  • Advise clients on performance management, promotions, career development, and compensation benchmarking with a consultative, solutions-oriented approach.
  • Support Embedded (reseller) and HR Consulting clients with tailored HR guidance, adhering to defined communication protocols, service standards, and process controls.
  • Prepare and manage employment contracts and HR documentation (offers, confirmations, compensation/title changes, probation extensions, renewals), while proactively tracking key dates such as probation periods and contract expirations.
  • Ensure compliance with local labor laws, GDPR, and internal policies by maintaining accurate employee records, HR documentation, and up-to-date policies and handbooks.
  • Collaborate with payroll and benefits vendors to ensure accurate payroll processing, tax filings, and social security submissions.
  • Support work permit processes (applications, renewals, cancellations) in coordination with legal and immigration partners.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate legal, compliance, and operational risks; escalate complex employee relations or legal matters as needed.
  • Lead and support HR initiatives and projects, including employee transitions, organizational changes, and terminations.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Legal, and Finance teams to ensure aligned and efficient HR service delivery.
  • Generate HR reports, support audits and due diligence processes, and respond to internal or client data requests.
  • Enhance employee experience through onboarding, engagement initiatives, regular check-ins, and effective offboarding processes.
  • Act as an escalation point for employee concerns, grievances, and conflict resolution, ensuring timely and appropriate action.
  • Identify process inefficiencies and implement improvements to optimize HR operations and reduce compliance risks.
  • Stay updated on employment laws and HR best practices across supported regions to continuously improve service quality

What will give you an advantage:

  • Requires 5-6 years of proven experience in HR management or HR business partnering, preferably in an international or Employer of Record (EOR) context.
  • Strong working knowledge of local and international labor laws, employment practices, and HR compliance.
  • Experience with global HRIS platforms and HR tools.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization abilities in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to handle complex issues and make data-driven recommendations.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential for interacting with employees, management, and external stakeholders. Fluent in English (additional language skills are a plus).

Who we are and what we do:

Safeguard Global is….Global! With offices worldwide, we help 1500+ companies hire, manage, and pay employees in 170+ countries. It's all about people! Join us to meet diverse folks, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe.

Our Global Benefits 

  • Autonomy & Flexibility (Work in Any Way): Be supported with as much flexibility as possible.  

  • Bonding Leave: Enjoy paid leave to bond with your new family member.  

  • 2 Charitable Days: Contribute to causes you believe in.  

  • Reward & Recognition Program: Be rewarded for your success and championing our values.  

  • Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan. 

Why become a Guardian: 

  • International Environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.  

  • Our Culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.

  • Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace. 

Next Steps: 

To apply, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time. 

Welcome to the Future of Work!

At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

Why join Safeguard Global?

We want to help you “Work in Any Way” - that makes time for family, commitments, and life outside, so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work.

Our roles aren’t just remote and hybrid first—they break free from the traditional ways of doing things, paving a way for A Job That Works for You.

The role in a nutshell:

The HR Services Manager plays a pivotal role in delivering high-quality, legally compliant HR Business Partnering support to a diverse portfolio of global clients, including Embedded clients (reseller) and HR Consulting clients. As the primary HR point of contact for workers, clients, and in-country partners, this role is responsible for effectively managing the full employee lifecycle and ensuring seamless coordination across all HR functions with defined service scope, SLAs and workflows. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of employment law, HR best practices, and the ability to lead complex HR initiatives in a fast-paced, global environment. This role also requires creative thinking, a can-do attitude, and a proactive, consultative approach to client needs. The HR Services Manager must anticipate client needs, provide up-front knowledge to mitigate risk, and ask probing questions to uncover the full context of client inquiries.

How you will make a difference:

  • Act as the primary HR point of contact for GEO workers and client stakeholders, delivering professional and compliant support across the full employee lifecycle (onboarding to offboarding).
  • Provide day-to-day HR and benefits support, including guidance on statutory and supplemental benefits (eligibility, enrollment, changes), ensuring clear and effective worker communication.
  • Deliver HR and benefits briefings aligned with local labor laws and company policies to ensure understanding and compliance.
  • Advise clients on performance management, promotions, career development, and compensation benchmarking with a consultative, solutions-oriented approach.
  • Support Embedded (reseller) and HR Consulting clients with tailored HR guidance, adhering to defined communication protocols, service standards, and process controls.
  • Prepare and manage employment contracts and HR documentation (offers, confirmations, compensation/title changes, probation extensions, renewals), while proactively tracking key dates such as probation periods and contract expirations.
  • Ensure compliance with local labor laws, GDPR, and internal policies by maintaining accurate employee records, HR documentation, and up-to-date policies and handbooks.
  • Collaborate with payroll and benefits vendors to ensure accurate payroll processing, tax filings, and social security submissions.
  • Support work permit processes (applications, renewals, cancellations) in coordination with legal and immigration partners.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate legal, compliance, and operational risks; escalate complex employee relations or legal matters as needed.
  • Lead and support HR initiatives and projects, including employee transitions, organizational changes, and terminations.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Legal, and Finance teams to ensure aligned and efficient HR service delivery.
  • Generate HR reports, support audits and due diligence processes, and respond to internal or client data requests.
  • Enhance employee experience through onboarding, engagement initiatives, regular check-ins, and effective offboarding processes.
  • Act as an escalation point for employee concerns, grievances, and conflict resolution, ensuring timely and appropriate action.
  • Identify process inefficiencies and implement improvements to optimize HR operations and reduce compliance risks.
  • Stay updated on employment laws and HR best practices across supported regions to continuously improve service quality

What will give you an advantage:

  • Requires 5-6 years of proven experience in HR management or HR business partnering, preferably in an international or Employer of Record (EOR) context.
  • Strong working knowledge of local and international labor laws, employment practices, and HR compliance.
  • Experience with global HRIS platforms and HR tools.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization abilities in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to handle complex issues and make data-driven recommendations.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential for interacting with employees, management, and external stakeholders. Fluent in English (additional language skills are a plus).

Who we are and what we do:

Safeguard Global is….Global! With offices worldwide, we help 1500+ companies hire, manage, and pay employees in 170+ countries. It's all about people! Join us to meet diverse folks, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe.

Our Global Benefits 

  • Autonomy & Flexibility (Work in Any Way): Be supported with as much flexibility as possible.  

  • Bonding Leave: Enjoy paid leave to bond with your new family member.  

  • 2 Charitable Days: Contribute to causes you believe in.  

  • Reward & Recognition Program: Be rewarded for your success and championing our values.  

  • Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan. 

Why become a Guardian: 

  • International Environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.  

  • Our Culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.

  • Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace. 

Next Steps: 

To apply, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time. 

Welcome to the Future of Work!

At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

About the Role
Team: Design
Reports to: Design Lead
Location: Remote

We are looking for a Communication Designer to own visual storytelling across all marketing channels - social media, advertising networks, product launches, campaigns, presentations, and landing pages. You will be the dedicated creative force behind how the brand looks and moves in the market, working closely with the Content and Marketing teams to produce graphics and motion that are on-brand, on-time, and impossible to scroll past.
This is a hands-on maker role with a high bar for creativity. You will go from brief to delivery independently, propose concepts proactively, and help build a scalable design pipeline for a fast-growing fintech product suite.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end production of marketing visuals: social media graphics, ad creatives, campaign assets, email visuals, and presentation decks.

  • Create motion design content (animated social posts, short ad clips, micro-interactions) using AI+ After Effects or equivalent tools.

  • Deliver landing-page visuals and collaborate with developers (Webflow) on implementation.

  • Translate marketing briefs into creative concepts - propose ideas and visual directions.

  • Maintain and extend the brand's visual identity across multiple related brands, ensuring consistency in typography, color, illustration style, and tone.

  • Build reusable marketing components, templates, and assets in Figma to accelerate future production.

  • Manage your own workload: provide honest time estimates, meet agreed deadlines, and communicate proactively when priorities shift.

  • Stay current with design trends, platform-specific format requirements, and emerging creative tools (including AI-assisted workflows).

Required Skills
Tools & Technical

  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma (daily driver for all design work).

  • Strong command of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for advanced compositing, illustration, and asset production.

  • Working proficiency in Adobe After Effects for motion graphics and short-form animation.

  • Familiarity with Webflow (or similar no-code/low-code platforms) for landing page implementation is a plus.

Design & Creative

  • Proven portfolio of communication/marketing design work - social graphics, ad creatives, campaign visuals, presentations.

  • Strong sense of layout, typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy.

  • Ability to work across a range of visual registers: bold and attention-grabbing for consumer audiences, restrained and trustworthy for B2B/fintech contexts.

  • Motion design skills: understanding of timing, easing, and storytelling through animation.

  • Attention to detail: pixel-precise, clean type handling, no sloppy artifacts.

Soft Skills & Working Style

  • Creative ingenuity - able to generate original, unconventional visual ideas.

  • Receptive to feedback: the team iterates intensively, and design critique is frequent and direct (focused on the work, not the person

  • Strong self-management: honest estimation, structured prioritization, reliable delivery on deadlines.

  • Clear communication - able to articulate the reasoning behind design decisions, not just present the output.

  • Comfortable with context-switching across statics, motion, presentations, and landings in a single sprint.

  • Self-directed and proactive: you see what needs to be done and propose it rather than waiting for a brief.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in or familiarity with fintech, crypto, or web3 - understanding the visual language, culture, and narratives of the space.

  • Experience producing assets for paid ad networks (Meta, Google, Twitter/X) with an understanding of format specs and performance constraints.

  • Comfort with AI-powered design tools and willingness to integrate them into your workflow.

  • Experience working in a multi-brand environment with several parallel visual systems.

  • Basic video editing or 3D skills as a creative bonus.

What We Offer

  • Full ownership of the communication design stream. Creative autonomy within a clear brand framework.

  • A direct, feedback-rich culture that pushes quality upward - your work will get better here.

  • A small, senior-level design team with short decision paths.

  • Exposure to a fast-moving international fintech/crypto productenvironment with multiple brands and audiences.

  • Competitive compensation range, depending on experience and location.

  • Flexibility on working arrangements (to be discussed).

Hiring Process
1. Application review (Portfolio review).

2. HR interview.

3. Interview with the hiring manager.

4. Final decision & offer.

    • Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities by connecting customer needs, behavioral signals, business performance, and emerging capabilities.
    • Translate those opportunities into clear product direction, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
    • Make portfolio tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, evidence, effort, risk, and learning potential.
    • Balance performance optimization, foundational capability, and longer-term innovation across the portfolio

  • Drive growth and journey performance

    • Lead the digital journey from initial need through quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
    • Identify where friction, uncertainty, or unnecessary effort is limiting conversion, self-service, or customer confidence.
    • Connect product decisions directly to revenue, margin, conversion, satisfaction, and operational performance.
    • Use behavioral data, research, experimentation, and customer signals to identify the highest-value opportunities for improvement.
    • Partner with Pricing, Marketing, and business leaders on how pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial levers appear within the experience.

  • Build an AI-enabled product practice

    • Establish how the team uses AI across discovery, analysis, synthesis, prototyping, experimentation, and product decision making.
    • Use AI-native tools to analyze customer behavior and interactions at scale, surface patterns, investigate performance, and identify emerging opportunities.
    • Help teams move quickly from signal to hypothesis to evidence while maintaining strong product judgment.
    • Build fluency across the team so AI becomes part of how product managers work, not a separate capability or occasional tool.
    • Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and determine where they can materially improve the consumer journey or the way the team works.

  • Shape AI-enabled consumer experiences

    • Identify where AI can create meaningful customer and business value across the consumer journey.
    • Partner with agentic product leadership to determine how conversational, agentic, predictive, and adaptive capabilities should integrate into the broader consumer experience.
    • Define opportunities where AI can improve self-service, decision support, personalization, and service outcomes.
    • Ensure AI-enabled experiences are grounded in customer value, measurable outcomes, appropriate controls, and clear expectations.
    • Connect emerging AI capabilities to the broader product roadmap rather than treating them as standalone features.

  • Lead and develop the product team

    • Lead, coach, and develop product managers responsible for areas within the consumer portfolio.
    • Set a high standard for product judgment, customer understanding, analytical fluency, experimentation, and execution.
    • Develop product managers who can form an independent point of view from customer behavior, data, research, and business performance.
    • Create ways of working that support continuous discovery and delivery while maintaining clarity around outcomes, priorities, and accountability.
    • Stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions, raise the quality of decisions, and help teams navigate difficult tradeoffs.

  • Lead through partnership

    • Operate as a close partner to Design and Engineering in shaping product strategy, priorities, and outcomes.
    • Partner across Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Contact Center, and business leadership to connect the digital experience to the broader service.
    • Align teams around opportunities, priorities, measures of success, and the decisions required to move forward.
    • Bring structure and clarity to complex product decisions when customer, business, technology, and operational priorities compete.

  • Performs other duties as assigned

  • Complies with all policies and standards

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience Required

Experience Qualifications

  • 7-9 years of product management or digital product experience, including significant ownership of consumer-facing digital products at scale. Required

  • Experience leading and developing product managers, with a track record of raising product judgment and team performance. Required

  • Experience owning digital products from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and continuous improvement. Required

Skills and Abilities

REQUIRED

  • Demonstrated success improving high-intent consumer journeys such as commerce, booking, quoting, scheduling, or self-service.
  • Strong analytical fluency and hands-on experience using digital analytics platforms such as Quantum Metric, Heap, Amplitude, FullStory, Mixpanel, or similar.
  • Demonstrated fluency using AI across product strategy, discovery, research synthesis, analysis, prototyping, experimentation, and optimization.
  • Experience using AI-native tools to investigate customer behavior, product performance, and emerging opportunities.
  • Strong experience with experimentation, A/B testing, funnel optimization, and evidence-based product decision making.
  • Ability to connect customer needs, behavioral signals, business strategy, and technology capabilities into clear product direction and investment priorities.
  • Experience working in continuous discovery and delivery environments where learning actively shapes the roadmap.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and the ability to create clarity in complex, ambiguous product environments.

TARGET EXPERIENCE

  • We are looking for a product leader who has led consumer digital experiences where customer behavior and business performance are tightly connected.
  • You have owned high-intent journeys such as commerce, booking, quoting, scheduling, or self-service and can show how product decisions changed conversion, revenue, satisfaction, or customer effort.
  • You have worked in environments where pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial decisions are part of the product experience, not separate from it.
  • You also know what strong product practice looks like. You have worked with dedicated cross-functional teams, continuous discovery, instrumented products, experimentation, and outcome-based goals, and you have helped raise the maturity of the product organization around you.
  • Relevant experience may come from marketplaces, on-demand services, travel and hospitality, omnichannel retail, home services, financial services, modern automotive experiences, or other businesses where digital demand connects to real-world service delivery.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience shipping AI-enabled, conversational, agentic, predictive, or personalized product capabilities.
  • Experience leading products that span both customer-facing and employee-facing digital experiences.
  • Experience with behavioral analytics, voice of customer, journey analysis, service design, and customer research methods.
  • Familiarity with APIs, data products, design systems, experimentation platforms, and the technical foundations of modern digital products.
  • Experience with products where digital conversion connects directly to operational capacity or service fulfillment.

CORE CAPABILITIES

  • Product Strategy. Turns customer, business, and technology signals into clear product choices, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • Consumer Journey Leadership. Understands the end-to-end journey and identifies where product can materially improve customer behavior, confidence, and outcomes.
  • Growth and Business Acumen. Connects product decisions to conversion, revenue, margin, satisfaction, and operational performance.
  • Opportunity Identification. Uses customer behavior, evidence, and business context to identify and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • People Leadership. Builds strong product managers and raises the quality of judgment, execution, and product practice across the team.
  • AI-Enabled Product Leadership. Uses AI directly to improve how the team learns and to identify where intelligent capabilities can create customer and business value.
  • Experimentation and Learning. Uses analytics, testing, research, and feedback loops to improve decisions and product performance continuously.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership. Aligns Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Pricing, Operations, and other partners around shared outcomes.
  • Execution Discipline. Turns strategy into sustained product progress while managing priorities, dependencies, risk, and performance.

About JerseySTEM

All JerseySTEM roles are pro-bono (unpaid) positions.JerseySTEM is a mission-driven professional network of pro-bono contributors dedicated to improving access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.

Members contribute their professional skills and leverage their networks in service of the organization’s gender-equity agenda.Membership is a minimum six-month commitment of approximately six flexible hours per week and includes a $100 refundable deposit, returned after six months of active membership. K–12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students are exempt from the deposit.

Overview

Moving beyond standard spreadsheet reporting, the Data Analytics Engineer focuses on data preparation and front-end business intelligence. Working within a collaborative team, this role is responsible for writing clean transformation queries to prep raw operational data and implementing high-impact operational dashboards that provide the organization with reliable information.

Responsibilities

  • Data Processing & Prep: Clean, aggregate, and structure raw operational data related to schools, colleges, and corporate partners. Consume data from tables managed by the Data Integration team and use SQL or data prep tools to turn them into optimized views for reporting.

  • Operational Dashboard Implementation: Design, develop, and maintain high-performing dashboards and visual reports using our standard toolset (Looker for now) to identify key trends and patterns.

  • Technical Query Execution: Write clean, optimized SQL queries and manage database view configurations to ensure frontend reporting sheets refresh smoothly, rapidly, and accurately.

  • Business Translation & Collaboration: Partner with team members to gather operational requirements, translate complex tracking metrics into intuitive layouts, and help drive data-backed organizational decisions.

  • Data Quality Assurance & Documentation: Implement rigorous validation checks to ensure dashboard numbers consistently align with actual system records. Contribute to internal documentation detailing data processing procedures to maintain team-wide consistency.
