You’ll be accountable for marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline and iARR across sales-led and partner-led motions, with visibility into self-serve iARR performance in lockstep with Sales, Partnerships, RevOps, and Product. This role owns the full line from data diagnosis to strategy to campaign, not just execution against a plan someone else set.

About the role:

  • Location: Remote-first (United States)
  • Full-time
  • Permanent
  • Exempt
  • The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.

    • United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
      • $268,000 - $335,000

This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals.

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for an existing vacancy
  • Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer

As a VP, Revenue Marketing you’ll …

  • Revenue & funnel ownership
    • Own marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline and iARR targets (new business + expansion), including forecasting, budget allocation, and channel ROI
    • Balance Demand Creation (category and awareness plays that create future pipeline) with Demand Capture (high-intent programs that efficiently convert in-market demand) with a clear view of CAC, payback, and Cost to Book by channel.
    • Build and optimize the full funnel: lead → MQL/PQL → SAO → closed/won, plus upsell/cross-sell motions
    • Own performance as our highest leverage pipeline channel: conversion, channel optimization, and demand capture, in partnership with Product and Brand on experience and design.
  • Team leadership & org design
    • Lead a multi-disciplinary Revenue Marketing org (demand gen, digital channel optimization, field marketing, partner marketing, lifecycle)
    • Build and scale a high-performing team aligned to our sales led and partner led motions.
    • Partner with peer Marketing Leaders to ensure integrated, end-to-end campaigns rather than siloed programs
  • Sales-led growth
    • Work with Sales leadership to prioritize segments and plays, and ensure marketing programs, SDR/BDR sequencing, and AE outreach are orchestrated around those plays
    • Build ABM/account-based plays for mid-market + enterprise in close partnership with SDR/BDR and AE teams
    • Build the Revenue ‘feedback loops’ from sales calls into messaging, offers, campaign strategy, and competitive positioning.
  • Partner-led growth
    • Partner with VP of Partnership to define partner-sourced pipeline targets by tier and region, and build the co-marketing and enablement programs to hit them
    • Build a partner tiering and activation model: recruit → enable → co-market → measure
    • Develop scalable plays for different partner types, including tech/integration partners, Agencies, and platforms.
  • Lifecycle, expansion, and retention
    • Own lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation to paid, re-engagement, expansion, and advocacy
    • Partner closely with CS and Product to design and test lifecycle journeys that improve time-to-value, expansion iARR, and multi-product attach
    • Operationalize customer proof as part of core sales plays, measured by win rate, attach, and cycle time
  • Customer Zero
    • “Act as ‘Customer Zero’ for Product: use Webflow internally at a high bar, surface friction and unmet needs, and translate real internal workflows into prioritized, testable product and GTM requirements.”
    • Lead in the AI transformation of our Revenue Marketing team.

About you:

Requirements:

  • 12-15+ years in B2B SaaS revenue marketing, including senior leadership ownership of pipeline and ARR
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize a data diagnosis into a stated strategic thread, and defend that thread.
  • Track record of building trust and results with a new team fast, specifically in the first 30 to 60 days. Clear, sized instructions to directs rather than high volume, ambiguous asks.
  • Proven ability to operate in a sales-led and partner-led model with visibility into self serve iARR performance; knows how these motions feed each other instead of competing
  • Experience building integrated revenue plays (not just channels); can design and run cross-functional plays from concept through enablement to measurement
  • Deep analytics and operating rigor: attribution approach, forecasting, budget optimization, experimentation discipline

You’ll thrive as a VP, Revenue Marketing if you:

  • Have credibility with Sales, Partnership, and Product: Known for creating alignment, clarity, and trust
  • AI-native working style: AI-native working style that produces judgement, not just volume. Uses AI to accelerate research and execution, and can articulate where AI output stops and their own synthesis starts.
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

Benefits

  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

raw.description:
Account Executive, New Business — Mid-Size Districts
Daybreak Health | 100% Remote | Full-time

About the role
Pure new-logo, outside sales. You generate your own pipeline and you close it. No renewals, no upsell book. Roughly 40% prospecting, 60% running deals end to end. You'll sell into school districts with 2,000–5,000 students across Daybreak's eight active states, where we already have signed partnerships and referenceable outcomes.

About Daybreak Health

Daybreak partners with school districts to make sure any student who needs mental health care can actually get it. The gap we're closing is real: the recommended ratio is one school psychologist per 500 students, and the national reality is closer to one per 1,200, which means families wait months while counselors carry impossible caseloads. We match every student to a clinician based on language, culture, identity, and what they're actually working through, usually starting care within a week or two of a referral and at no cost to the family. It works. 81% of students improve on standardized clinical measures, 92% of families report meaningful behavioral change at home, and 80% of school staff see better attendance, grades, and behavior. We're backed by Union Square Ventures, Lux Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Maven Ventures, and Y Combinator, and we already serve districts representing more than a million students. That still leaves most of the country without an answer, which is exactly where this role comes in.

What you'll do

  • Self-source the large majority of your pipeline through cold outreach, regional conferences, cabinet-level networking, and referrals from current district partners
  • Hit weekly and monthly activity targets on calls, emails, sequences, and conference touches
  • Partner with Marketing's lead-gen motion, including AI-assisted outbound tools, to turn sourced leads into qualified meetings
  • Run every deal solo: discovery, demo, proposal, close, ideally under 30 days
  • Navigate Superintendents, Student Services Directors, and Special Education and Mental Health leaders
  • Hand off closed-won districts to CSM activation-ready with a clean transition brief

Skills

  • Outbound prospecting and pipeline generation
  • Full-cycle closing (discovery through contract)
  • Public sector and K-12 district selling
  • Multi-stakeholder navigation
  • Salesforce and CRM hygiene
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Practical use of AI tools for personal productivity

Who thrives here

  • Genuinely likes prospecting as much as closing
  • Self-directed and comfortable owning your own number without hand-holding
  • High activity tolerance, steady week over week
  • Resilient with cold outreach and long silences
  • Mission-driven about student mental health
  • Coachable and willing to share what works with the team

Qualifications

Must-haves

  • 3–6+ years of outbound B2B sales with a track record of self-sourced pipeline
  • Experience selling into K-12 districts or comparable public-sector buyers
  • Comfort with faster, less-layered mid-size district cycles
  • Confident running discovery and demos solo
  • Salesforce proficiency

Nice-to-haves

  • Built or improved a prospecting playbook other reps adopted
  • Existing relationships with Superintendents, Cabinet, or Student Services leaders in our active states
  • Familiarity with Title IV, IDEA, Medicaid, and state mental health funding and how they shape buying timelines
  • High-growth startup experience on a lean, metrics-driven GTM team
Pay Range
$120,000—$180,000 USD

Position Title: Engineer I

JOB SUMMARY

They will learn, through hands-on application, how to design a wide variety of projects. This person will work as part of the Engineering Team and interact closely with the Project Management Team to produce construction documents, assist in project specifications and assist in the construction administration process.

Engineers in this role may choose to pursue a project management–focused career track, gain exposure across all three MEP disciplines (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing/Fire Protection), or progress toward deeper specialization. Specialization paths may include Mechanical, Electrical, or Plumbing/Fire Protection design, as well as advanced focus areas such as Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Power Systems Studies, Information and Communications Technology (ICT), or other mission-critical engineering specialties, based on individual interests, strengths, and business needs.

The Engineer I will rely on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job.  This person will work under immediate supervision.

The Engineer I will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

ASSIST IN PRODUCTION OF ENGINEERING DOCUMENTS (50%)

  • Perform basic engineering work and design tasks under a senior engineer’s supervision
  • Perform standard computations and analysis
  • Perform load calculations, equipment selection and pressure drop calculations
  • Utilize AutoCAD and Revit software to prepare drawings and visual aids
  • Assist in the review and creation of drawings details, schedules, sequence of operations and drawing content as directed

ASSIST IN PRE-CONSTRUCTION ACTIVITIES (15%)

REPORTING (10%)

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

TRAINING REQUIREMENTS

The Senior Cyber Resiliency Engineer develops and supports technical capabilities that strengthen incident response and cyber resiliency across the enterprise. Areas of concentration include alert triage, technical analysis, incident investigation, threat identification, containment, SIEM and EDR platforms, security monitoring, and exposure management. Assist in the development and implementation of cybersecurity procedures, playbooks and standards. Identify inadequacies and propose solutions to improve the organization's ability to detect, analyze, contain and recover from cybersecurity incidents. The Senior Cyber Resiliency Engineer will also mentor team members, assist with projects, and maintain technical documentation.

Responsibilities

Works with the SOC to monitor alerts, analyze suspicious activity, and investigate cybersecurity incidents. Provides incident response to security threats, with emphasis on identification, scoping, containment, and technical response coordination. Performs technical investigations using endpoint, network, identity, cloud and log data to determine root cause and affected systems. Assists in the development and maintenance of SIEM, EDR, alerting, detection content and response procedures. Evaluates and supports cybersecurity tools and technical capabilities that strengthen incident detection and containment. Partners with infrastructure, application, exposure management and other IT teams to identify and remediate security gaps. Documents investigative findings, incident actions, evidence and improvement opportunities. Participates in tabletop exercises, incident simulations and technical validation activities to improve response readiness. Works closely with legal, compliance, privacy and other departments to support coordinated incident management activities. Monitors emerging threats, vulnerabilities and threat intelligence, and recommends improvements to detection and response capabilities. Mentors team members on incident response procedures, investigations, security tools and documentation.

  • Use frontline, client, customer, and operational insights to recommend improvements to processes, resources, technology, and service delivery.
  • Ensure operational improvements are effectively implemented, measured, and sustained within the assigned area.

Lead Through Change and Support Technology & AI Adoption

  • Lead teams effectively through ongoing business, regulatory, process, and technology change, providing clarity, communication, and direction as circumstances evolve.
  • Execute established business and transformation priorities within the assigned operational area, ensuring leaders and team members understand expectations and are prepared to deliver.

  • Partner with Technology, Operations, and other stakeholders to implement automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and other technology solutions within the assigned operational area.

  • Support responsible adoption of new capabilities by gathering feedback, reinforcing new processes, monitoring results, and maintaining appropriate operational and quality controls.
  • Identify opportunities within the assigned area to leverage approved technology and AI capabilities to improve efficiency, consistency, decision support, and client and customer experiences.

Partner to Achieve Business Objectives

  • Collaborate with Absence Claims peers and matrix partners to support consistent practices, resolve operational challenges, and achieve established business objectives.
  • Partner effectively with Operations, Technology, Product, Client Management, Legal, Compliance, and other functions as needed to deliver operational priorities.
  • Provide Absence subject matter expertise and operational perspective in cross-functional discussions and client engagements.
  • Work collaboratively across teams to resolve issues, address dependencies, and support timely execution of business priorities.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 5+ years of progressive leadership experience within Absence, disability claims, leave administration, or a comparable complex operational environment preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of Absence and disability programs, including Short-Term Disability, FMLA, state and statutory leaves, company leave programs, paid and unpaid leave, and ADA administration.
  • Demonstrated success leading operational teams in a complex, high-volume, customer-focused environment.
  • Proven ability to lead teams effectively through significant and ongoing change while maintaining employee engagement, service, quality, and operational performance.
  • Demonstrated experience using continuous improvement, structured problem-solving, data, and operational insights to improve business outcomes.
  • Strong people leadership skills, including the ability to set clear expectations, coach performance, engage employees, and build team capability.
  • Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make timely decisions, adapt established plans and priorities, and operate effectively amid ambiguity and competing demands.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners to achieve operational objectives.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with leaders, clients, team members, and cross-functional partners.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and urgency.
  • Ability to be onsite for team activities, meetings, and other events, with willingness to travel based on business needs.

About Appriss Retail

Appriss Retail is the total retail loss solution for omnichannel, unifying high-quality data across stores, online, and customer ser-vice to reduce returns, cut shrink, and manage incidents. Our products—Engage to reduce returns, Secure to cut shrink, and Incident to centralize visibility—help retailers move from reactive loss control to strategic profit protection. Together, they empower organizations to make better operations decisions, strengthen accountability, and put hundreds of millions back to the bottom line. Covering 40% of all U.S. transactions and active in 45 countries, Appriss Retail is trusted by 60+ of the top 100 U.S. retailers to deliver lasting performance improvement. Learn more at apprissretail.com.

About the Role

Appriss Retail is looking for a Solution Expert to serve as the go-to product authority for our Incident and Audit solutions. Incident gives LP, operations, and compliance teams a single place to open, work, and close every case — from shoplifting and ORC to safety and audit findings. Audit applies those same principles to operational compliance, replacing paper checklists with a centralized, scored auditing system. In this role, you'll bridge the gap between the product and the people who sell, implement, train, and support it every day.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the internal and customer-facing subject matter expert on Incident and Audit functionality, workflows, and best practices
  • Support sales and customer success teams during demos, discovery calls, and QBRs by speaking fluently to product capabilities and value
  • Deliver customer training sessions — onboarding, ongoing enablement, and named-session packages — to drive adoption and proficiency
  • Help customers configure and optimize their use of Incident and Audit — case linking, audit scoring, checklist digitization, and analytics
  • Provide advanced product support, troubleshooting complex customer issues and escalating appropriately when needed
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to relay customer feedback, identify gaps, and inform the roadmap
  • Create and maintain training materials, playbooks, and FAQs for internal teams and customers
  • Stay current on retail loss prevention and compliance trends relevant to Incident and Audit use cases

What You Bring

  • Experience with case management, compliance/audit software, or loss prevention systems (retail industry experience a plus)
  • Comfort delivering live training or enablement sessions to customers, individually or in groups
  • Strong communication skills — comfortable explaining technical workflows to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • A customer-first mindset with the ability to translate product features into business value
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Sales, CS, Product, and Support
  • Prior experience in a solution consultant, product specialist, training, or support role

Benefits

At Appriss Retail, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being at work and beyond. Benefits begin on your first day and include multiple medical plan options, dental and vision coverage, health savings and flexible spending accounts, paid parental leave, and supplemental coverage for life’s unexpected moments. We offer generous paid time off, a 401(k) with immediate vesting and company match, short- and long-term disability, and free access to health and wellbeing resources such as Calm and Sworkit. You’ll also have access to learning and development opportunities to help you grow your career. Our benefits support your well-being so you can perform your best in every part of life.

Reports to: Director, Solution Experts

Department: Product / Customer Success

Supervisory Duties: No

Travel Required: Yes, 10-15%

Location/Work Region: Remote - United States

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected characteristics.

Job Title:

Customer Marketing Manager

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Our growth depends on the strength of our client relationships and the stories we tell about the work we deliver.
We are looking for an experienced Customer Marketing Manager who knows how to turn client success into market credibility. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Account Management, Delivery and Marketing. You will identify the right stories, secure the right approvals and ensure we show up with credible, referenceable proof.
You bring positive, client-friendly energy. You are confident, professional and easy to work with. You know how to build trust quickly and navigate approvals without friction.

This is not an entry-level advocacy role. We need someone who has built case study pipelines, managed references and worked confidently with enterprise clients before.
The mandate is clear: Surface the right wins. Build advocacy. Strengthen credibility in the market.

What you will do in this role

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.

Identify and Activate New Logo and Project Wins

  • Partner with Sellers and Account Managers to identify new logo wins and significant project milestones.
    • Assess opportunities for website announcements, news releases and coordinated communications.
    • Work with PR and Communications teams to amplify client stories appropriately.
    • Engage clients professionally and positively to secure approvals and participation.

Build High-Impact Case Studies and Client Stories

  • Proactively identify strong case study and reference opportunities across services and product engagements.
    • Develop written, video and presentation-ready client stories.
    • Ensure stories are commercially relevant and aligned to priority industries and propositions.
    • Maintain a structured pipeline of publishable and referenceable content.

Develop and Manage Customer Advocacy Programmes

  • Build and scale a structured client reference programme that supports Sales and Marketing.
    • Recruit and nurture client advocates for speaking engagements, events and PR opportunities.
    • Develop Customer Advisory Boards or similar engagement forums where appropriate.
    • Track reference usage and ensure a positive, professional client experience throughout.

Work Cross-Functionally with Commercial Teams

  • Build strong relationships with Sellers, Account Managers and Delivery teams.
    • Educate internal teams on how and when to surface client stories.
    • Balance commercial ambition with client relationship sensitivity.

Support Awards and Industry Recognition

  • Identify opportunities for joint client awards and industry recognition programmes.
    • Partner with PR and Marketing to manage submissions.
    • Ensure client success is visible in the right forums.

Objectives & Measures of Success

  • Increased volume and quality of referenceable client stories.
    • Growth in published case studies aligned to strategic industries and growth areas.
    • Increased availability and responsiveness of client references for Sales.
    • Successful coordination of client announcements and milestone communications.
    • Strong internal feedback from Sellers and Account Managers.
    • Positive feedback from clients participating in advocacy programmes.

Your qualifications

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you have:

Essential

• Fluent English speaker

Proven experience in a B2B Customer Marketing, Advocacy or Reference Management role.
• Experience working in enterprise services, SaaS or technology environments.
• Demonstrable track record building and managing client case study and reference programmes.
• Experience working directly with Sales and Account Management teams.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, including navigating client approvals and sensitivities.
• Excellent written communication skills with strong commercial judgement.
• Professional presence and confident client-facing communication style.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience in both services and product-led environments.
    • Exposure to enterprise PR and communications processes.
    • Experience establishing or managing Customer Advisory Boards.
    • Familiarity with CRM systems and reference tracking tools.

Core Competencies & Leadership Capabilities

• Positive, client-friendly energy.

  • Commercially aware and relationship-focused.
    • Confident engaging senior client stakeholders.

• Highly organised and process-oriented.

• Proactive and opportunity-driven.

  • Trusted partner to Sales and Account teams.

Posting Date

09/01/20262800 N Loop WestSte 800, Houston, Texas, 77092-8838, United States of America

Are you passionate about, and have experience in, reimagining care delivery for patients with chronic conditions? If you thrive in dynamic environments and want to shape innovative solutions that improve outcomes and reduce healthcare costs, this could be the next step in your career.

DaVita is seeking a Director, IKC Clinical Programs to help drive forward our value-based care strategy for patients with chronic kidney disease and kidney failure. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and innovation—offering the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to transformative initiatives that directly impact patient lives.

You’ll play a critical role in designing, piloting, and scaling care interventions in close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including clinical, analytics, operations, and product. This position is perfect for a strategic thinker who’s ready to move from consulting or healthcare operations into a more hands-on, mission-driven leadership role.

Key responsibilities are spread across three categories:

Strategy

  • Evaluate the effectiveness and scalability of field initiatives and prepare markets for the launch of new integrated care programs

  • Partner and collaborate with key teams across the Village to drive this strategy to fruition

  • Determine how to best organize our frontline and field leadership teams to best deliver integrated care for ESKD patients

  • Collaborate with key stakeholders across the Village to design scalable solutions for our teams and work to build consensus around recommendations

  • Evaluate the performance of current initiatives and complete analysis to understand best opportunities to improve clinical outcomes and reduce total cost of care

Innovation

  • Gap analysis of where new processes or products could enhance clinical quality and teammate efficiency

  • Evaluation of ideas generated by field teammates and business stakeholders

  • A continuous improvement mindset, adopting an iterative approach to testing

  • An integrated care thought leader in developing the next generation teammate facing IT systems

Pilots and experimentation

  • Performs hypothesis development, research, insight generation, and business recommendations

  • Leads the development, piloting, deployment and measurement of outcomes for processes and workflows that drive the IKC Care Model

  • Builds complex models and conducts financial planning and analyses to assess impact on business metrics

  • Conveys findings in a cohesive story, including summarizing insights from analysis

  • Distills complex business problems into cohesive, impactful stories

  • Build consensus for best demonstrated practices across several stakeholders

Travel: ~15% of the time

Here is what you can expect when you join our Village:

  • A "community first, company second" culture based on Core Values that really matter.

  • Clinical outcomes consistently ranked above the national average.

  • Award-winning education and training across multiple career paths to help you reach your potential.

  • Performance-based rewards based on stellar individual and team contributions.

  • A comprehensive benefits package designed to enhance your health, your financial well-being and your future.

  • Dedication, above all, to caring for patients suffering from chronic kidney failure across the nation.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required

  • 6+ years of work experience in management consulting, process engineering, investment banking or a corporate strategy role preferred. Recent experience working in value-based care preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience and/or interest in healthcare delivery and patient experience

  • Strong analytical and presentation skills are preferred

  • Highly collaborative with the ability to impact change

Additional Skills:

  • Demonstrated ability to recognize, prioritize, and evaluate workload and specific growth opportunities

  • Possesses the ability to balance strategic vision and execution capabilities to deliver results

  • Proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel

  • Comfort with ambiguity

  • Outstanding conceptual, analytical and strategic skills; strong business and financial acumen with a sense of shareholder responsibility

  • Possesses the ability to balance strategic vision and execution capabilities to deliver results

  • Strong executive communication skills

  • Ability to effectively handle and drive multiple projects with multiple teams

  • Willingness to understand the complexity of healthcare markets

What We’ll Provide:

More than just pay, our DaVita Rewards package connects teammates to what matters most. Teammates are eligible to begin receiving benefits on the first day of the month following or coinciding with one month of continuous employment. Below are some of our benefit offerings.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, paid time off, PTO cash out

  • Support for you and your family: Family resources, EAP counseling sessions, access Headspace®, backup child and elder care, maternity/paternity leave and more

  • Professional development programs: DaVita offers a variety of programs to help strong performers grow within their career and also offers on-demand virtual leadership and development courses through DaVita’s online training platform StarLearning.

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

The DCX Client Services Home-Based Embroidery Digitizer has a strong ability to listen to the client, understand their goals, and assist in the creation of creative solutions with a high visual impact. This role will work closely with the design and production teams to ensure every piece embroiders cleanly, accurately, and efficiently. Your creativity, attention to detail, and understanding of design principles will play a vital role in shaping the visual identity and success of the client's brand.

REQUIRED CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating a range of design skills and creativity across different mediums

  • Able to give and receive constructive criticism 

  • Strong understanding of design principles, visual composition, and details

  • Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and clients

  • Effective time management skills and the ability to meet deadlines 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Convert vector/raster artwork into embroidery machine files (e.g., .DST, .PES, .EXP) using digitizing software

  • Select appropriate stitch types (satin, fill, running) based on design and fabric

  • Adjust stitch density, underlay, and pull compensation for different fabric types

  • Resize and adapt existing designs for different garments or hoop sizes

  • Maintain an organized library of digitized files

  • Communicate with designers to clarify design intent and revision

​Requirements

  • Proven experience digitizing for embroidery (portfolio required)

  • Proficiency with digitizing software (e.g., Wilcom, Hatch, Embird, Tajima DG)

  • Strong understanding of fabric types and how they affect stitching

  • Excellent attention to detail and color/shape accuracy

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

  • Basic knowledge of embroidery machine operation a plus

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

  • Education:Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communication, or related field.

  • Experience:1-3 years of professional digitizing experience

  • Language Proficiency: Strong verbal, written, and English communication skills.

  • Working schedule: Ability to work overnight/graveyard shifts in Philippine time or within US operating hours.

  • Technical Skills: Experience with 3D puff, applique, or specialty stitching

über uns – talentspring academy group

Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mithalten können – aber die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht? Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland verfügen über keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss. Gleichzeitig transformieren KI, Automatisierung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle ganze Branchen – schneller, als das Bildungssystem reagieren kann. In nahezu allen zukunftsrelevanten Sektoren fehlen qualifizierte Fachkräfte. Der Fachkräftemangel ist längst strukturell – und mit ihm wächst die Dringlichkeit, Menschen gezielt und wirksam neu zu qualifizieren.

Genau hier setzen wir an: Mit digitalen, staatlich geförderten Weiterbildungen, die Menschen beruflich neu aufstellen, Chancengleichheit stärken, digitale Kompetenzen breit vermitteln – und so den Wirtschaftsstandort Deutschland langfristig zukunftsfähig machen.

Die Talentspring Academy Group ist ein dynamisch wachsender Verbund staatlich anerkannter digital-first Bildungseinrichtungen mit klarem Fokus auf digitale Berufsfelder. Wir qualifizieren Menschen ohne formalen Abschluss, Quereinsteiger:innen und Arbeitssuchende und Arbeitnehmende für gefragte Tätigkeiten in der digitalen Arbeitswelt – staatlich zertifiziert, praxisnah und anschlussfähig. Unsere Programme qualifizieren für zukunftsrelevante Berufsfelder in Bereichen wie Künstliche Intelligenz, Online Marketing und Digital Sales – flexibel gestaltet, arbeitsmarktnah und mit echten Karriereperspektiven.

Was uns besonders macht: Wir verbinden die Geschwindigkeit und Innovationskraft eines EdTechs mit der Reichweite und Glaubwürdigkeit etablierter Bildungsstrukturen. Durch strategische Partnerschaften im Bildungssektor verfügen wir über eine bundesweite Infrastruktur mit mehreren hundert Standorten, tiefem institutionellem Vertrauen und direktem Zugang zu unseren Zielgruppen – über digitale wie lokale Kanäle. Das schafft Marktzugang, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Skalierbarkeit in einem regulierten Umfeld.

Wir stehen vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschub – mit klarem Produkt-Markt-Fit, KI-first-DNA, gesellschaftlichem Hebel und einem einzigartigen Marktzugang, den kein anderer Anbieter in dieser Form replizieren kann.

Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt, um einzusteigen – und mitzugestalten, wie Bildung in Deutschland neu gedacht wird. Bist Du dabei?

über die rolle

Du suchst eine sinnstiftende Aufgabe neben dem Studium, möchtest Deine Marketing-Kompetenz weitergeben und anderen helfen, in der digitalen Arbeitswelt Fuß zu fassen?

Als Teaching Assistant (m/w/d) bist Du die zentrale Bezugsperson für unsere Teilnehmenden – motivierend, unterstützend und lösungsorientiert. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Dozierenden zusammen und begleitest die Studierenden durch ihren Lernprozess: nicht als klassische Lehrkraft, sondern als Coach, Wegbereiter:in und Sparringspartner:in auf Augenhöhe.

Du hilfst Menschen dabei, ihr Leben zu verändern.

deine aufgaben

  • Lernbegleitung mit Wirkung: Du unterstützt unsere Teilnehmenden bei der Bearbeitung von praxisnahen Online-Marketing-Projekten und stehst bei Fragen als erste Anlaufstelle zur Seite – empathisch, lösungsorientiert und geduldig.

raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

As Stripe continues to develop innovative products that serve businesses of all sizes, risk will increase in complexity and scale. The Industry Expansion Strategy team protects Stripe's business and mission by building the policies, frameworks, and practices that enable Stripe to support businesses in complex, highly regulated industries. As Stripe expands into new markets and products, we unlock revenue, advance trust, and set the standard for what responsible growth looks like at scale.

What you’ll do

Stripe's financial infrastructure only works if merchants can trust it—and that trust depends on us staying ahead of card network requirements. The Industry Expansion Strategy team owns that problem globally. As part of the team, you'll be the person who ensures our merchant portfolio stays compliant with Visa, Mastercard, and other card network rules as Stripe scales globally.

This isn't a passive monitoring role. You'll work directly with Sales, merchants, card networks, and internal Risk and Compliance teams to catch issues early, fix them fast, and build processes that move Stripe ahead.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about navigating ambiguity, enabling business growth while balancing risk, and is skilled at identifying ways to improve user experience.

Responsibilities

  • Own oversight of merchant risk management processes for Payment Facilitators, Marketplace, and other Third Party Agents/Servicers, including: preparing merchants for card networks registration, managing network reporting requirements, periodic reviews and user remediations.
  • Partner with internal teams to design compliance strategies that support Stripe's global expansion without creating major downstream risks
  • Embedding within first line teams, particularly Sales and Product, to train sellers to develop the judgment to catch gaps and position Risk as a business enabler
  • Build new processes and enhance existing processes to optimize for efficiency and automation, manage incoming non-compliance escalations from partners, and monitor our portfolio against rules & requirements
  • Perform research and analysis to assess Stripe's current market position and develop and prioritize long-term strategic plans for future growth
  • Challenge the status quo and provide multiple alternative solutions and key execution criteria.
  • Execute special projects and ad hoc analyses as initiatives, products, risks, and opportunities are constantly evolving

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in a related role in Payments or FinTech industries, including experience with card network compliance
  • Familiarity with banking and money movement regulations, including KYC and KYB, AML OFAC compliance, and credit and fraud risk
  • Experience overseeing design execution and delivery of highly strategic programs.
  • Proven ability to take complex issues and turn them into actionable next steps, hold others accountable, and meet deadlines
  • Data-driven problem-solving skills, including the ability to distill complex, ambiguous regulatory issues into clear, concise, and reliable guidance for stakeholders and Stripe users
  • Demonstrated track record of deriving insights from complex or technical problem spaces and evangelizing actionable product recommendations
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and operating rigor, including the ability to take ownership, be accountable, and lead without formal authority to navigate ambiguity and solve problems with the end user in mind
  • Entrepreneurial and curious mindset, including motivation to develop deep subject matter expertise and understanding of risk-based frameworks
  • Strong operating rigor, executive presence, and presentation skills, including experience engaging with leadership
  • Experience in a client-facing role managing relationships with large, global organizations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong desire to work in an innovative, fast-paced, 0 - 1 environment
  • A strong understanding of Stripe's business and products and an ability to research and self-start

  • Systems engineering experience designing and operating complex, distributed enterprise platforms.

  • Hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows using GitLab, Jenkins, Nexus, JFrog or equivalent tooling.

  • Identity data analytics ability — designing queries, building pipelines, and deriving actionable insights from operational or identity data sets.
  • Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong knowledge of distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and software quality principles including reliability and observability.
  • Proven ability to mentor engineers and lead cross-functional technical initiatives from conception to delivery.
  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on identity governance.
  • A growth mindset and a passion for staying on top of new technologies and industry trends.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance optimization
  • 10+ years of experience with Java, C#, or another high-level, compiled language
  • 5+ years of experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Selenium, Playwright, TestNG) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with enterprise Identity governance platforms (e.g. SailPoint, Veza) or ServiceNow platform integrations (ITSM/ITOM/workflow).

  • Exposure to regulated or compliance-constrained environments (FedRAMP, GCC, or equivalent).

raw.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The ASTRO Systems Product Management team has end-to-end ownership of the ASTRO systems product portfolio, including Core, Consoles, RF Site and System Management. The team is responsible for business cases, product definition & requirements, planning, value propositions, key selling points, success metrics, launch and sunset of assigned products. The product managers work closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, supply chain, marketing, sales and finance for the definition, on time delivery and profitability of products.


Job Description

The RF Site Product Manager will lead the process responsible for the vision, strategy, roadmap, and feature definition for assigned RF Site products including closely interfacing with customers and internal stakeholders. The product manager is the person responsible for defining the ‘why’, ‘what,’ ‘where’, and ‘when’ of the products that the development team will build. They are the owner of their product -- which means they lead cross-functional teams from a product's conception through to its launch.

The product manager should possess deep industry expertise necessary to analyze market and competitive conditions and lay out a product vision that is differentiated and delivers unique value based on customer demands. The role of the product manager spans many activities from strategic to tactical and provides cross-functional leadership — bridging gaps within the company between different functions, especially between development, sales, marketing, support and finance.

Product management responsibilities include:

Product Strategy

The product manager is responsible for setting a product vision and strategy. Their job is to clearly articulate the business value to the product team so they understand the intent behind the new product or product release. They own the strategy behind the product along with its roadmap and must work with development to define, prioritize and build what matters.

  • Create and manage the product portfolio, roadmap, vision and backlog

  • Identify customer needs and market requirements

  • Ensure solutions are compliant with relevant standards and regulations

  • Evaluate competitive intelligence

  • Define financial goals

  • Create business plans and proposals for new initiatives

  • Strategic partner and third party supplier management

Product Releases

Product managers must plan for what their teams will deliver and when they will deliver it. The product manager owns the HW and SW release aspects of the product. Release responsibilities include managing HW and SW features and dependencies in and across releases, product and support teams; and managing releases with phases and milestones.

  • Establish vision and goals for releases

  • Define market offer and structure

  • Work with enablement organizations to make products orderable and deliverable

  • Define and support implementation of training, support and deployment requirements

  • Manage risks and resolve issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality

  • Coordinate overall release project and schedule

Product Vision

Collecting, curating, and promoting the most relevant ideas into features. Defining which ideas should be promoted to features to achieve key objectives for the product line and business. Soliciting feedback and requests from customers and field teams and ensuring this is seamlessly integrated into the product planning and development processes.

  • Consistently gather customer and sales feedback

  • Perform ‘Voice of Customer’ research to ensure their needs are understood

  • Evaluate success of launched initiatives and adjust strategy as necessary

Feature Definition

The product manager defines the features and requirements necessary to deliver a complete product to market and lead the product team to success. They are responsible for articulating the ‘why’ and ‘what’, working with go to market to determine the ‘where’, and working with development to determine the ‘when’.

  • Create epics, initiatives, user stories and scenarios

  • Direct, negotiate and approve hardware and software development plans

  • Define acceptance criteria, KPIs and SLAs

Go-to-market Support

Responsible for making product decisions and often is the lead resource for the rest of the organization when deep product expertise is required. This includes supporting the organizations that help bring the product to market by working directly with internal stakeholders including marketing, sales, training and support services.

  • Facilitate sales and channel training

  • Assist pre-sales with custom project requests

  • Define and ensure implementation of GTM assets including demo environments, training materials, and presentations

  • Demonstrate new pre-release features

Additional Qualified Skills:

  • Thorough knowledge of Motorola’s ASTRO or competitive Project 25 (P25) systems including Conventional and Trunked systems, deployments and components

  • Experience validating market problems based on industry experience and contact with customers and stakeholders

  • Experience gathering customer feedback and research

  • Technical acumen to communicate effectively with development engineering and technical end users

  • Strong ability to lead through influencing others within and outside of the organization

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

  • Polished presentation skills for external and internal audiences including customers and leaders

Desired:

  • Product level financial modeling via Excel, Google Sheets or Tableau (preferred)

  • Experience with North American Public Safety & Federal markets

  • Familiarity with P25 RF Site subsystem components including base stations and comparators

  • Firm understanding of software design & user interaction

  • Proactive, enthusiastic attitude toward challenging problems

  • Capable of quickly evaluating and prioritizing new projects alongside customer feedback

  • Strong ability to take complex user requirements and distill them into a format that can be understood by developers as well as non-technical staff

  • Ability to research and analyze product requirements from various stakeholders

  • Ability to understand market trends, financial data, and customer needs and assess competitive intelligence data

  • Ability to work well independently and as part of a diverse team spread across multiple continents in a fast-moving environment

Target Base Salary Range: $106,500 - $153,000 USD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.


Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree degree OR 5+ years of experience.

  • 3 + years progressive, relevant technology experience in: Product Management, Product Marketing, Field Service, Field Engineering or Development Engineering


Travel Requirements

Under 10%

None

Experienced


Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Our U.S. Benefits include:

  • Incentive Bonus Plans

  • Medical, Dental, Vision benefits

  • 401K with Company Match

  • 10 Paid Holidays

  • Generous Paid Time Off Packages

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Paid Parental & Family Leave

  • and more!

Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

Come join Peak Health – a fast-growing provider led health plan as a Regulatory Business Analyst. Your data management and analysis skills combined with your critical thinking will help us advance operational performance across Peak Health by transforming raw data into actionable intelligence that improves efficiency, throughput, quality, and member/provider experience.

The Regulatory Business Analyst will be an integral resource within the Operational Analytics department, and collaborate closely with peers and colleagues, across product, operations, medical management, provider contracting, and compliance to support the development and submission of regulatory reporting.

The ideal candidate will provide operational guidance and technical support for Center for Medicare & Medicaid (CMS) report deliverables. This position will utilize your understanding of government healthcare reporting, CMS data specifications, underlying data elements, and the ability to write SQL code to create standardized reports. The candidate will support internal stakeholders and data owners, clients, CMS, CMS vendors, and external data auditors.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Bachelor’s Degree in Health Administration, Business Administration, Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related field.

EXPERIENCE:

1. Five (5) years of experience monitoring, managing, manipulating, and drawing insights from data in a managed care company.

2. Three (3) years of experience working with claims, enrollment, appeals, and grievances data for regulatory submissions.

3. Epic Certification or Accreditation for Cogito, Caboodle Data Model, and Clarity Data Model or the ability to obtain such certification or accreditation within 60 days of hire.

4. Three (3) years of experience in data analytics to include software, modeling, ETL processes, data warehousing, and visualizations.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EXPERIENCE:

1. Three (3) years of experience working with Medicare, Medicaid, TPA, and/or ACA data.

2. Three (3) years of experience working with claims data to evaluate reimbursement changes, payment discrepancies, medical expense opportunities, and quality outcomes.

3. Strong understanding of healthcare regulations (ACA, CMS guidelines, State regulatory agencies) and regulatory reporting.

4. Strong understanding of quality rating programs (e.g., Medicare Advantage Star Ratings, ACA QRS).

5. Experience with health plan operations and data architecture.

They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Monitor and analyze existing and new regulations affecting all Peak Health lines of business.

About Us

Aptitude 8 is the leading HubSpot solutions consultancy for companies with complex CRM operations, advanced tech stacks, and ambitious growth goals. We design and implement CRM, data, automation, and RevOps solutions that unlock revenue performance and operational excellence. You’ll join a rapidly scaling team of builders and operators who want to experiment, solve hard problems, and deliver outcomes that matter.

At Aptitude 8, you’ll find remote flexibility, 401k, great benefits, meaningful work, and the chance to shape the future of how companies operate!

About the Role

We’re looking for a HubSpot Solutions Consultant to join our Delivery Team! In this client-facing role, you’ll be responsible for leading technical implementations and integrations, designing solutions, and ensuring the successful execution of HubSpot-related projects. You’ll work closely with Delivery Leads, Developers, Engineers, and other Solutions Consultants to bring projects to life! This role blends strong technical expertise with work execution and project management while ramping up new client consulting skills and subject matter expertise to deliver high-value solutions and drive business outcomes.

A Normal Day in this Role...

Solution Design & Implementation

  • Collaborate with internal teams to deliver client projects, such as implementations, integrations, migrations, and custom developments, on the HubSpot platform.
  • Develop scalable, tailored solutions that address client business needs, leveraging HubSpot's advanced features and third-party integrations.
  • Provide valuable advice for clients while bringing strategic value regardless of relationship or technical familiarity with the existing ecosystem.
  • Confidently and accurately build strategies to solve complex problems using HubSpot-centered solutions.
    • Strategically identify additional areas for HubSpot solutions that align with client goals and objectives.
  • Create diagrams and process maps (using tools like LucidChart) to illustrate solutions clearly.

Client Engagement

  • Act as a point of contact for clients, contributing to discovery sessions and clearly defining solution requirements.
  • Drive sprint cadence, plan work accordingly, and conduct weekly sprint meetings with clients.
  • Present technical concepts as actionable business use cases, ensuring clarity and alignment with client goals.
  • Manage and lead user acceptance testing (UAT) with clients, ensuring deliverables meet quality expectations.
  • Train clients on deliverables and platform processes; lead train the trainer and direct training sessions.

Collaboration & Delegation

  • Work closely with Delivery Leads and technical resources to execute tasks, provide guidance, and ensure seamless execution.
  • Write detailed task specifications and delegate to other team members as needed.
  • Conduct quality assurance (QA) on deliverables and provide coaching to team members where needed.

Technical Expertise

  • Plan, configure and manage HubSpot features, including workflows, custom objects, APIs / webhooks, and 3rd party systems integrations.
  • Execute data migrations, property setups, and 3rd party app integrations to ensure seamless transitions for clients.
  • Stay updated on HubSpot beta features and other technological advancements (including AI) to deliver cutting-edge solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of professional experience in at least one functional area, preferably Technology, Sales, or Marketing.
  • 3+ years experience in larger-scale CRM implementations or comparable project work, ideally in consulting or professional services environments.
    • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining client scope and budget.
  • Strong technical grasp of 3+ HubSpot hubs (Marketing, Sales, Service, Data/Ops, Content/CMS)
  • Solid understanding of third-party systems integrations, data modeling, migrations, and API/webhooks.
  • Understanding of systems, architecture, and complex problem-solving using data, technology, and process.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a client-centric mindset; ability to listen to clients and translate their pain points into real solutions.
  • Ability to navigate project constraints and lead clients toward the right solutions within a defined scope of work.

raw.description:
Fixed-Term Contract | Remote, Australia

Ocado Group is a UK-based company and one of the world's largest dedicated online grocery retailers. Through our innovative Ocado Smart Platform ("OSP"), we provide advanced robotics and automation technology to grocery partners globally. In Australia, our technology powers highly automated Customer Fulfilment Centres supporting our local partner, Coles.

About the Role:

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Specialist to join our Australian People team on a fixed-term contract, commencing as soon as possible through to July 2027.

Ocado is currently undertaking a global payroll transformation, transitioning towards a shared services model. During this period, you’ll provide continuity and senior payroll expertise for our Australian business, ensuring payroll continues to be delivered accurately, on time and in line with Australian requirements.

As our senior local payroll subject matter expert, you’ll own Australian payroll delivery and navigate complex matters including Enterprise Agreements, Modern Awards, annualised salaries, employee entitlements and time and attendance.

This isn’t a purely transactional payroll role. You’ll also help identify risks, strengthen controls, manage external providers and support the transition of Australian payroll into our future shared services model, including knowledge transfer to future delivery teams.

This role can be based remotely anywhere in Australia. Ideally, you’ll be Melbourne-based or able to attend our Truganina site for a small amount of training and knowledge transfer during the first month or so, generally no more than a couple of consecutive days at a time. Following this initial period, the role can be completely remote.

The day to day for a Senior Payroll Specialist may involve:

  • Delivering accurate and timely Australian payroll, including reviewing calculations, outputs and reconciliations.
  • Managing complex payroll transactions, discrepancies, over/underpayments and employee queries.
  • Providing expert advice on Australian payroll legislation, Enterprise Agreements, Modern Awards and employee entitlements.
  • Supporting compliance reconciliations, including annualised salaries, and implementing payroll changes and back payments.
  • Overseeing time and attendance inputs and resolving exceptions with operational teams.
  • Managing external payroll and system providers, validating outputs and driving issues through to resolution.
  • Maintaining payroll controls, audit evidence, governance reporting and identifying payroll risks or control gaps.
  • Supporting the transition to our future shared services model through testing, validation, documentation, training and knowledge transfer.

About You:

We’re looking for an experienced payroll professional who knows Australian payroll inside and out, enjoys solving complex problems and is comfortable working autonomously.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Senior-level end-to-end Australian payroll experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Australian payroll legislation and statutory obligations.
  • Experience interpreting Enterprise Agreements and/or Modern Awards and applying employee entitlements.
  • Strong experience with payroll reconciliations, complex discrepancies, governance and controls.
  • Experience managing external payroll providers and confidently challenging outputs where required.
  • Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills, including reconciliations and remuneration modelling.
  • Experience supporting payroll implementation, transformation or service delivery change.
  • Strong analytical, stakeholder management and communication skills with excellent attention to detail.

Experience with annualised salary arrangements, time and attendance systems, Workday or another enterprise HRIS, or transitioning payroll into a shared services environment would be highly regarded.

What's In It for You:

  • A genuinely flexible role that can be completely remote following the initial training and handover period (the training can be negotiated to be remote also).
  • The opportunity to be the senior Australian payroll SME during an important period of global transformation.
  • The chance to make a real impact, helping ensure Australian payroll requirements are understood and embedded into our future operating model.
  • Exposure to local and global teams across Payroll, People, Finance and transformation.
  • Subsidised private healthcare.
  • Access to salary sacrifice schemes.
  • A range of amazing benefits, including Free Shares and Life Assurance.
  • Access to Discounts+.
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Programme.

If you’re an experienced Australian payroll specialist who enjoys solving complex problems, taking ownership and making sure things are done properly, we’d love to hear from you.

Research shows that some candidates, particularly women and people from underrepresented backgrounds, may be less likely to apply for a role unless they feel they meet every requirement. If this opportunity excites you and you feel you could be a great fit, but you don’t tick every box above, we’d still really encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you.

Ocado is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, gender, religion, age, disability, veteran’s status, or any other classification as required by applicable law.

Applicants must have unrestricted working rights in Australia, as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

raw.description:
About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

    • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
    • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
    • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
    • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)
    • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
    • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

Role Overview :

We are looking for a driven Telesales Executive (Kannada - speaking) to support Lokal App’s growth by engaging potential users through outbound calls and converting leads into customers. This role involves understanding user needs, pitching relevant solutions, managing the sales funnel end-to-end, and consistently achieving monthly sales targets.

You’ll work closely with the marketing team to capitalize on campaigns, maintain accurate CRM records, and provide on-ground customer insights that influence future strategies. This is an ownership-heavy role suited for someone who enjoys targets, conversations, and real impact.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct outbound calls to prospective clients and effectively promote Lokal App's services.
  • Engage with users to identify their needs and create tailored solutions that fit their requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of calls, interactions, and leads in the CRM system.
  • Follow up on leads and manage the sales process from initial contact through to closing.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to leverage campaigns and enhance sales efforts.
  • Provide feedback on customer interactions and market trends to help shape future strategies.
  • Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of Lokal App.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Kannada and a good command of English.
  • Previous experience in tele sales or sales roles is preferred.
  • Excellent verbal communication and persuasive skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with CRM software, Excel and sales tracking tools is a plus.
  • Motivated and goal-oriented individual with a passion for sales.
  • Experience required: 1 Year (Minimum).

Why Join Us?

We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

About the Role:

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will have the opportunity to collaborate closely with senior engineers and product leaders as part of your team. Together, you'll develop and enhance Instacart's ads systems. You will use machine learning to devise and refine solutions in crucial areas such as ads selection, ranking, bidding, and auction across all of Instacart’s consumer facing surfaces and Ads Ecosystems. You will actively contribute to initiatives, assisting in all stages of ML projects from the initial concept, through prototyping and experimentation, to final launch.

About the Team:

The Ads Response Prediction team owns systems, algorithms and ML models to ensure a relevant and engaging Ads experience to customers of all the platforms powered by Instacart. This includes search and exploration retrieval systems, Sequential Modeling and Generative Retrieval systems, LLM integrations, relevance models, pCTR models, bidding models and Foundation Models. The team optimizes for an efficient marketplace to ensure customers see ads that help them try new products/brands, advertisers boost their product sales for a good return on investment, and instacart generates the deserving revenue as well.

About the Job:

  • Design, develop, and deploy machine learning solutions including data pipelines, model architectures and serving integrations to tackle practical challenges in the ads organization.
  • Formulate and scope ambiguous modeling problems from first principles. Translate business observations (e.g., miss-calibration patterns, cold-start underperformance) into well-defined ML research directions with clear evaluation criteria.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and infrastructure engineers to deeply understand business needs and create impactful ML applications.
  • Push the envelope on our operational efficiency by continually refining and advancing our algorithms and models.
  • Publish and present findings internally. Contribute to the team’s culture of technical rigor through design reviews, paper sharing, and experiment retrospectives.

About You:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Have a graduate degree (masters or PhD) in machine learning, statistics, computer science, information retrieval, or a closely related quantitative field.
  • Have strong programming skills and fluency in data manipulation (SQL, Spark, Pandas) and Machine Learning (classical ML and Deep Learning) tools.
  • Have strong analytical skills and problem-solving ability.
  • Are a strong communicator who can collaborate with diverse stakeholders across all levels.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Have 1-2 years of industry experience using machine learning to solve real-world problems with large datasets.
  • Knowledge of sequential modeling, Transformer architecture and Foundation Model.
  • Familiarity with LLM integrations, agentic workflow and productivity tooling.
  • Experience in building large scale online recommendation systems.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

Reports to: Director of Bookkeeping
